PLAN "12-Week Post-Meniscus Strength Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild lower body strength for skiing return"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Reconditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower A - Reconditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Lower B - Posterior Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          shoulder_stretch 1m
